decisions.question: S07 asks for two governance touches: add topology-dsl@v1 to ADR-003's affects (ADR-003 items 3 and 4 constrain its live guarantees G22 and G23), with ADR-001 item 4's wording 'live topology builder' aligned to the plan-interpretation path; and correct the root's OQ5 detail, which says server rewiring is 'covered by topology-dsl@v1's switchMap'. When do these run?

options.label: One touch step each, now
options.consequence: Each fix lands immediately, at the cost of interleaving small hsdd-adr and hsdd-spec steps between contract steps, and of re-touching the same ADRs again if later contracts raise similar links.

options.label: Batch after the last root contract
options.consequence: One hsdd-adr step after S14 fixes every ADR affects and Governed-by link and any ADR wording the nine contracts exposed; one root hsdd-spec touch fixes root prose. Until then the gate keeps reporting the links as warnings, and contract steps read the contracts, which already state the binding facts.

decisions.chosen: Batch after the last root contract
decisions.why: Neither touch blocks a contract step: S07's contract states the guarantees ADR-003 constrains, and S09 is told where the live binding goes. The next seven contracts are likely to expose more links of the same kind (bus-api@v1 and bus-testing@v1 against ADR-003, flutter-binding@v1 against ADR-001's binding rule), and one pass over them costs less than several. The signal that would change this: a contract step that misreads an ADR because of a missing link.
